text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tore-san! 
It's coming into view—the first sunrise of 
the year!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, 
it's beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Happy New Year, 
Tore-san!

Early on New Year's morning, at Daring 
Tact's request, 
we came to watch the first sunrise. This 
secluded beach 
was a place she had apparently visited 
once before—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this is a beach Daring Heart and 
I found together.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, the two of us hiked into an 
unfamiliar mountain, 
and navigating the unfamiliar terrain 
proved quite difficult...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
We worked together pushing through the 
thickets, 
when suddenly, our view opened right up—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And there was this boundless ocean 
spreading before us.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to share the wonder I felt 
back then 
with you too, Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel? 
Doesn't it feel like your spirit is being 
cleansed?

We quietly watched the sun slowly rise. 
The peaceful, breathtaking scenery brought 
warmth to my heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know. 
How about we shout our New Year's 
resolutions to the sea?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I just remembered 
something Daring Heart taught me—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Shouting at the ocean feels so 
refreshing!" 
I figured shouting our goals would be 
perfect.
choice_data_list:
(I see, so that was Daring Heart's 
idea...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll go first, then... 
...Haaah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to achieve feats that surpass 
the Triple Tiara! 
I'm going to become an incredible horse 
girl...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... Yes, that really does feel 
refreshing! 
Please, give it a try too, Tore-san!

Encouraged by Daring Tact, I faced the 
ocean. 
My resolution for this year is—
choice_data_list:
I'm going to make sure Tact gets tons of 
rest--!!

I'm going to support Tact with everything 
I've got--!!

I'm going to get stronger than 
Tact-------!!

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact gave it her all throughout the 
past year. 
This year, I want to make sure she gets 
all the rest and recovery she needs.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Tore-san? 
What on earth are you doing...?
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, Tact, just sit back and 
relax!

text_block_list.text:
I racked my brain trying to think of ways 
to help her relax. 
Her shoulders still seem a little tense, 
so I want to help her unwind a bit more, 
but...
choice_data_list:
...Oh, maybe I can fan you with this palm 
frond!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what...! 
I-I'm really fine, truly...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

And so, after spending the day together... 
On our way back to Tracen Academy—

The goal Daring Tact has set is truly 
grand. 
To help her achieve it, 
I want to support her more than ever 
before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! 
I'll be counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if you don't mind right 
away... 
there's something I'd like to consult you 
on regarding training.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Back then, I felt like the air resistance 
was quite high when pushing forward. So, 
I was hoping to ask for your guidance on 
what to do.
choice_data_list:
I see. In that case, let's first try 
replicating it—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, isn't that... Daring Tact?! 
...Looks like they're talking about 
something pretty intense, though...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day? Those two 
have such a fresh aura about them... 
They're really serious, aren't they?

And so, after spending the day together... 
On our way back to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san... you were trying to become 
stronger during last year's summer camp 
too, weren't you? 
Even more than that?
choice_data_list: I just want to... get stronger!!
I just want to... get stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... 
...Understood. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Halfway up this cliff, there is a cave. 
Let us climb up to it!
choice_data_list:
It has an overhang like a rat barrier, 
though...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is the perfect wall to grow stronger. 
I will support you, so...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Like fresh bamboo shoots, 
let us sprout right up and grow!

And so, after spending the day together... 
On our way back to Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Look, Tore-san! 
That shop over there was closed before, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
There are even people passing through here 
and there...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back in Hidaka, tourists seem to be 
visiting little by little again... 
Everyone was so happy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...We still need to stay vigilant, of 
course, 
but one step, two steps... things are 
starting to connect.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A day will come when they're packed full 
of spectators once again. 
...Right!

With her spirits newly renewed, 
Daring Tact and I headed to the track for 
training 
at her request, when—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or does it seem 
quite lively out here...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You! 
1600m is fine for today, right?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Sure, sounds good! 
Just promise we do 2400m next time, okay?♡

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hup... ho! 
Alright, warm-up complete!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, Daring Tact! 
Man, I didn't expect to see you here too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, what is all this excitement about...? 
Around this time last year, 
there were hardly any people around.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's fired up, of course! 
—Convinced that this year's protagonist is 
gonna be them!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With Almond Eye, the undisputed 
protagonist, taking a break right now, 
who's gonna step up as the next face of 
the racing world?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be ME! 
...That's why everybody's giving it their 
all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Of course, Daring Tact... 
everyone is keeping a watchful eye on you, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
As our reigning Triple Tiara horsegirl— 
and having fought your way through the 
Japan Cup, 
your strength—everyone knows it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Your dedication has surely watered 
so many blooming flowers— 
mine included, of course.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Curren Bouquetd'or...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The grand blossoms you have brought into 
full bloom— 
even the budding flowers of today must be 
looking up to them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
The budding flowers of today—

text_block_list.name: Efforia's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's wrong? 
Efforia.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. 
...I just felt like something called out 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Bloomed, bloomed, 
the Triple Tiara flower has bloomed!" 
"Daring Tact has—"

text_block_list.name: Young Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Titleholder! These Yezo gentians 
look so pretty on your ears..."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
...It's about time I get going. 
—To where you are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Buds...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It won't just be my 
seniors, 
from now on, I'll be facing the younger 
generation as well...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—And don't forget your own generation, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Win Marilyn!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Don't go thinking things are settled 
between us... 
How sad would that be?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Though 'The Tale of Win Marilyn: Chapter 
Two' 
is still very much in the drafting 
phase... 
Naturally, I intend to write in our 
inevitable rematch.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Will you wait for me until then?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Of course I will!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My heart is just racing with excitement... 
To think I get to race 
alongside such incredible people.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was in Hidaka, 
I never could have imagined a future like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you really are something... 
Even after becoming such an amazing 
horsegirl, you haven't changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
See you later, Tact. 
—Let's both shine bright again this year!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
Let's make this another great year 
together!
